request.description: Adds a question. `type`: `single_select`, `multi_select`, `number`, `money` (paise), `date`, `text`, `boolean`, `city` (city id from the city search), `pincode`. The type must suit the attribute's data type. Select options map each choice to the fact it records (`fact`), e.g. `"1-3"` → `{"min": 12, "max": 35}` months; facts are checked against the attribute. `validation` takes `min`/`max` (number, money), `minLength`/`maxLength`/`pattern` (text) or `maxSelections` (multi-select). `ui` holds rendering hints. Staff only. Reading needs question read access (ops lead, compliance, support); changes need question manage access (ops lead, super admin). Changes are audited and published as `question.changed`. Published question sets keep the snapshot they were approved with, so editing a question only affects sets submitted afterwards.
